eagle.title: Apollo Lunar Module (NASA 3D Resources)
eagle.notes: Generic Apollo LM (not LM-5-specific). Source GLB was Draco+WebP; decoded to plain mesh + PNG textures. +Y up, metres (~5.1 m tall). Contains 135 animation clips from the source: do NOT set autoplay on <model-viewer>. Mirror: github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources '3D Models/Apollo Lunar Module'.

viking1.title: Viking Lander (NASA 3D Resources)
viking1.notes: Untextured (flat materials, renders white/grey with a few coloured parts). Plain GLB copied as-is (no Draco). Upright in model-viewer. Has 2 animation clips: don't set autoplay. Generic Viking lander, fits Viking 1 and 2.

insight.title: InSight Lander, 3D Model (NASA/JPL-Caltech), deployed
insight.notes: Deployed config: solar arrays open, SEIS + wind shield and HP3 mole on the ground. Source 24880_InSight_deployed.glb 22.4 MB / 178k tris -> simplified to ~62% tris, PNG->JPEG textures, KHR_mesh_quantization (core three.js/model-viewer support, no decoder needed; not Draco/meshopt). +Y up.

ingenuity.title: Mars Ingenuity Helicopter, 3D Model (NASA/JPL-Caltech)
ingenuity.notes: Source 25043_Ingenuity_v3.glb used as-is (plain GLB, JPEG textures); only fix: clamped one baseColorFactor 1.0000001 -> 1.0 so it passes glTF validation. Upright in model-viewer.

nulls.surveyor3: No official NASA 3D model of the Surveyor lander found (checked science.nasa.gov 3D Resources + resource API, NASA-3D-Resources GitHub incl. 2022 history, archived nasa3d.arc.nasa.gov listing, Eyes on the Solar System model list, NASA SVS). Closest NASA 3D: Apollo 12 Landing Site printable terrain STL (science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/apollo-12-landing-site/), no spacecraft. Use a photo/still instead.
nulls.alsep: No official NASA 3D model of ALSEP or any ALSEP instrument found (same sources). Closest: NASA 3D Resources 'Apollo 11 Landing Site' terrain STL; Smithsonian NASM holds a Passive Seismic Experiment artifact but no NASA 3D scan found. Use photo.
nulls.rover16: No official NASA 3D model of the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle found (same sources). Only community CC0/paid models exist (Blender Artists CC0 LRV, Sketchfab, CGTrader): not NASA. Fallback idea: show eagle.glb (Apollo LM) or a photo.
nulls.sojourner: No official NASA 3D model of Sojourner or the Mars Pathfinder lander found. Eyes on the Solar System lists 'Mars Pathfinder' but with no model; its only related asset is the MER/MPF cruise stage (eyes.nasa.gov/assets/static/models/sc_mars_exploration_rover/cruise/mpf_mera_merb_cruise.gltf), not the rover. Closest official rover: assets/models/opportunity.glb (successor MER).
nulls.phoenix: No official NASA 3D model of the landed Phoenix lander found. JPL Eyes has only cruise (sc_phoenix/cruise/phoenix_cruise.gltf) and EDL aeroshell (sc_phoenix/edl/phoenix_edl.gltf = heat shield + backshell, lander hidden) at eyes.nasa.gov/assets/static/models/. Closest official lander: assets/models/insight.glb (InSight reused Phoenix's lander design).

_notes.viewer: All files are plain GLB with embedded textures; no Draco/meshopt. insight.glb uses KHR_mesh_quantization (supported natively by model-viewer/three.js). All pass gltf-transform validate with 0 errors and were render-tested in model-viewer 4.0 headless.
